book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Pure Mathematics 1
book.author: Sue Pemberton
book.policy: Book informs topic sequence and methods. Teaching prose, numerical examples and quick checks are independently written; no book images or exercise text are reproduced.

syllabus.section: 1.8 Integration: rational powers of linear expressions (n not equal to -1), constants, definite integrals, simple improper endpoints, areas and volumes about either coordinate axis. No logarithmic, trigonometric or exponential integrals, integration by parts or non-linear substitution.

local_syllabus_review.note: Rational powers of linear expressions, constants, definite and simple improper integrals, areas and volumes about either coordinate axis. A supplied derivative can identify an integral; no integration by parts, logarithmic/trigonometric/exponential integrals or new nonlinear-substitution technique is introduced.
